subject.title: feat: add disposable Vercel and Convex PR previews

question: Should this PR land before shared Production/auth/OpenAI Vercel variables are removed from Preview targeting or guarded by a fail-fast preview build check?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds disposable preview infrastructure and the discussion says current account permissions could not remove some Preview targeting, which is an operator security boundary outside deterministic code review.

options.title: Require preview secret cleanup
options.body: Do not merge until an admin removes Preview targeting for production-only secrets or the build fails closed when known production-only secret variables are present in Preview.

options.title: Accept SSO-gated rollout risk
options.body: Merge with the current SSO-gated preview setup and track the remaining Vercel environment cleanup as an operator follow-up owned by maintainers.

options.title: Pause preview rollout
options.body: Hold the PR until the team defines the permanent Preview environment policy and which secrets, if any, previews may receive.

recommendation.title: Require preview secret cleanup
recommendation.body: Do not merge until an admin removes Preview targeting for production-only secrets or the build fails closed when known production-only secret variables are present in Preview.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current history on the deploy/seeding baseline and authored the PR proof describing the unresolved Preview environment cleanup.
